carriedForward: The repair is not on bend2-rewrite: the kit at 831d25b8 lacks 4c2be1c4, so the next trial landing needs the rebuilt kit executable, as the added record states.

The compiler used is the existing Bend 2.0.25 executable (BEND=/Users/wahargis/Development/Experiments/bend2-trial/.bend/bin/bend); no toolchain was installed and nothing outside this seat's checkout was written.

My verification ran in two scratch worktrees inside the assigned checkout and both were removed with git worktree remove --force and pruned; the branch is unchanged at f643762f and the kit was read only.

After the kit is rebuilt, the next trial landing whose worker branch has several commits is the check to run: its message should carry the tip subject and every branch subject oldest first, with the trailer, and its tree should equal the worker tip's.
